text: Using the CHERI Alliance Trademark CHERI® is an open technology, but there are conditions to use the CHERI brand, please check the policy, and conform to the guidelines on this page. Trademark Policy The CHERI Alliance Trademark Policy ensures the CHERI name and logos are used accurately and fairly, supporting our mission to advance CHERI technology. It applies to all, even non-members. Certain uses require explicit permission, please check the full document. For questions or permissions, please contact us.
